proves: Deterministic docs catalog scan and metadata extraction include nested topics such as features-fleet-health.
Unsafe topics, duplicate topics, symlinked outside files, unsafe/unsupported links, outside-root links, and missing docs targets are explicit failures.
Route docTopic metadata is backed by the central docs catalog.
MCP docs list/read/resource paths consume the scanned docs catalog.
bahia_docs_read points agents to bahia_docs_list rather than embedding a static topic list.
bahia://docs/features-fleet-health appears without special casing.
/api/v1/docs and /api/v1/docs/{topic} return catalog/document/link data from the central service.
Missing/invalid docs topics and missing docs roots are explicit errors.
Docs routes reject writes and do not expose Nostr command metadata.
Docs refs resolve into Documentation References with title/topic/source/href metadata.
Docs context is bounded by MaxChars and unresolved docs refs are non-fatal.
Operational selected references continue to resolve alongside docs refs.
The docs API client uses GET-only /api/v1/docs paths.
The /docs catalog page renders grouped topics and explicit API failure states.
The docs reader sanitizes Markdown HTML, rewrites internal links from central resolutions, preserves external links, and handles not-found topics.
Docs home and route docs metadata derive from consolidated nav links.
Required route docs topics include services, deployments, fleet-health, LLM routes, and ML models.
Every nav docTopic exists in docs/user-guide.
Route-derived docs refs are visible in the assistant composer and submitted as selectedRefs.
Docs refs can be dismissed without removing operational refs.
publishAssistantPrompt still sends selected_refs through encrypted assistant/prompt payload construction.
Every live route page is classified in the route transport matrix.
Docs routes are allowlisted only as http_native read-only docs queries.
Pure signer-first routes do not import REST clients for command ingress.
